entities.name: Skollten
entities.description: Mountainous cold region of Tamingazin on Otaria, home to a tribe of squat, hairy humans.

entities.name: Garan
entities.description: People who passed through Skollten on their journey south from the far north.

entities.name: Viashino of Suderbod
entities.description: Viashino who mockingly call Skollten's humans apes.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: Place where Skollten has an ambassador to the Valley of Tamingazin.

events.summary: The Garan leave their faraway home in the north and pass through Skollten, ending their journey in the Valley of Tamingazin.
events.quote: the Garan left their faraway home in the north, they passed through Skollten

relations.quote: Skollten is a region of Tamingazin on the continent Otaria on Dominaria .
